text: Workday's Class A common stock was listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol WDAY on October 12, 2012, the date of its initial public offering; in September 2017 Workday announced it was transferring the listing to the NASDAQ Global Select Market.
short: Workday has been public since its October 2012 IPO.

source.name: Workday, Inc. – Form 10-K for fiscal 2013 (SEC)
source.quote: Our Class A common stock has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “WDAY” since October 12, 2012, the date of our initial public offering.

additionalSources.name: Workday press release: Workday to Transfer Stock Listing to NASDAQ
additionalSources.quote: today announced it will be transferring its stock exchange listing from the New York Stock Exchange to The NASDAQ Global Select Market ("NASDAQ") effective Sept. 19, 2017 after market close.
